description: This file defines the core game state and logic for a Tic Tac Toe mobile game. It includes enums for marks, game modes, game results, and an extension for display labels. The main class, GameState, manages the game board, current player, scores, game mode, and implements game logic such as move validation, CPU move selection, game state evaluation, and move reset functionalities.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class that maintains the state of the Tic Tac Toe game, manages game logic, player moves, CPU moves, scoring, and game resets.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the game mode (vsComputer or twoPlayers) and resets the game board without clearing scores.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to its initial state; optionally clears scores.

methods.name: resetScores
methods.description: Resets the player scores (X and O) to zero.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Handles a player move at a specified index, including validation, updating the board, triggering CPU move if applicable, and notification.

methods.name: _afterMove
methods.description: Evaluates board after a move to update scores, current player, and winning line.

methods.name: _chooseCpuMove
methods.description: Determines the CPU's move based on a simple heuristic: win, block, center, corners, sides.

methods.name: _findWinningMove
methods.description: Finds a winning move for a specified mark if available.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Evaluates the current board for ongoing, win, or draw states.

methods.name: _extractWinningLine
methods.description: Returns the line indices of the winning combination if exists.
